svg.text: each Monster irrep is a tile carrying its prime faces; slide equal tiles on top of one another, twice.
start with all 194 laid out flat — finish with the stacks (every pile is verified, not hand-placed).
194 tiles laid out — rank + prime faces all visible
move 1: stack equal tiles (same rank + face) (−24)
move 2: merge equal faces into one stack (−10)
prime faces — the fifteen Monster primes (a tile's lit studs are the primes dividing its dimension):
“Do not attack the object. Raise the water until only its essential structure remains.”
— the rising sea, after Alexander Grothendieck · stacks machine-checked in MahjongCollapse.lean
